brief:
The United Nations has warned of escalating humanitarian crisis in Gaza, saying stockpiles of essential supplies have become insufficient, according to Shehab Wire. The agency cited funding shortages and continued strict restrictions hampering the ability of humanitarian partners to deliver aid into the territory.

The warning reflects mounting pressure on relief operations across Gaza as international organizations struggle to maintain assistance flows. Humanitarian partners face compounding obstacles in accessing and distributing food, medicine, and other critical materials to civilians dependent on outside support. The UN statement comes as conditions in the enclave deteriorate amid the ongoing constraints on aid entry and distribution networks.
